scope: Independent shadow calls on actual current input/top-k and real CPU weights; original verification executes first and original model output is returned unchanged.

Shadow positives require finite, allclose(.01,.01), and bitwise identity; the fixed wrong-map negative requires finite and bitwise difference. Original native partial-group validation still requires only finite/allclose.
Per-layer 21 private plus 43 shared physical slots; all 64 experts mapped into two 384-slot shadow tensors. global_num_experts=384 describes the operator indexing domain, not a 384-expert model.

Qualification allocates additional pool/reference/sorting/workspaces and performs synchronization/readback. No same-budget performance, cross-layer shared-pool lifecycle, request-quality or generalized bitwise guarantee is established.
Allocator peaks retain the runner high-water scope and are never reset here. Allocated deltas are boundary observations, not isolated peak attribution.
